name: it5-r4-decision-config
standing: draft 2026-09-25: priors and test performances marked todo are placeholders awaiting R1-R3; every other number is a stated R4 config choice, swept in the tornado
framing: triage heuristic over stated weights; not a calibrated posterior, not a probability of benefit, not advice for or against giving any drug to any patient
combine_source: R4 choice: a drug's utility is its best single argument; 'noisy_or' would reward convergence, which iteration 4 measured at chance level (entry 155, H094 refuted)

missense_class.source: the register's triage weight for H084 ('the missense is destabilising', supported 0.55): ThermoMPNN ddG at the 87th percentile of 19,950 BubR1 substitutions, buried, pLDDT >= 90 (docs/iteration4/step-9/methodology/149-the-stability-atlas-and-the-childs-missense.md). The same entry's calibration (AUROC 0.60, 95% CI 0.13-1.00, n = 8; H083 refuted) says the predictor cannot yet separate the classes, so this is a weight, not a probability
missense_class.todo: R2 / R3: replace if a measured BubR1 abundance for this or an equivalent missense is found (protein-level proteomics or a quoted Western blot); otherwise keep and read the sweep

readthrough_feasible.source: placeholder: no iteration-4 measurement bears on it
readthrough_feasible.todo: R1 supplies: P(read-through of the child's stop codon restores enough full-length BubR1), from the stop codon identity, its +4 context, NMD (nonsense-mediated decay) escape and the published measured read-through of comparable premature stops

applicability._doc: factor in [0, 1] that a row's mechanism branch acts in a world-state; a variable not listed for a branch does not affect it

safety.source: R4 choice. Order follows iteration 4's K2 rule (both sources flag = fail, one = caution; docs/iteration4/step-10/methodology/155-convergence-and-checks.md, method of entry 152); magnitudes are not measured. 'unassessed' (drug absent from the per-child table) is below 'unflagged' by design: no flag is not safety

control.source: R4 choice. A route whose positive control failed is uninterpretable (docs/iteration5/notes/exploratory-no-hypotheses.md; the lesson of entry 153); 'penalty' keeps its rows visible at a quarter weight, 'exclude' drops them

baseline.name: defer (no drug; run the test first)
baseline.source: the reference action: every utility is relative to not acting on this list

tests.name: chx_chase_blot
tests.source: the experiment named in submissions/track2/iteration-4/report.md 7.3: a BubR1 Western blot with a cycloheximide chase (protein decay rate) in the child's cells against the parents'. Performance is an R4 assumption, swept 0.6-0.99 in the tornado
tests.todo: R3: a quoted performance or replicate agreement for cycloheximide-chase half-life calls, if the literature states one

tests.name: readthrough_reporter
tests.source: optional: a dual-luciferase read-through reporter carrying the child's stop codon and context. Performance is an R4 assumption
tests.todo: R1: the reporter's published agreement with protein-level rescue, if its positive-control papers state one

tornado_todo: add route:<id> rows (low 0.5, high 1.0) once R1-R3 fix the ids they write in the 'route' column
